Many Indian parents dream of sending their children to study abroad. But the reality is that education costs — both in India and overseas — are rising much faster than most people expect. A course that seems affordable today could cost several times more by the time your child is ready for college.
In this video, Aastha Khurana explains how parents can start planning early for their child’s future and the different investment options available to build that fund over time. The focus isn’t just on growing money, but also on creating a structured plan that keeps long-term goals on track.
